subject: Re: Credit buffer & VAT routing for Q1 consumption
messages:
From: Aria Kumar <accounts@thermocare.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Niels Petersen <niels.p@thermocare.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Credit buffer request and VAT routing for Q1 consumption

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the onboarding call yesterday — excited to get Redwood running for our predictive maintenance pipeline. A couple of asks from our side to make the finance side of the pilot move quickly:

1) Temporary credit increase: Our initial PO covers expected consumption through March but our demand profiling suggests a short-term overshoot. Can ThermoCare get a temporary credit buffer of $125,000 (one-off, repayable by April 30) and Net45 payment terms for the invoices generated in Feb–Mar?

2) VAT handling: We're EU-headquartered and would prefer reverse-charge on Redwood invoices. We'll attach our VAT registration and PO. Can you confirm Redwood's VAT treatment and any invoicing changes required?

If you need a Finance contact, loop Niels. We can sign an amendment or an SOW addendum if that's easiest.

Attachments: TC_PO_2027Q1.pdf, ThermoCare_VAT_certificate.pdf

Thanks,
Aria
Accounts Payable | ThermoCare Ltd

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Aria Kumar <accounts@thermocare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Credit buffer request and VAT routing for Q1 consumption

Aria — thanks for the clear ask and attachments. Joining finance here to review credit and tax. High level: Redwood can accommodate a short-term Net45 window for Feb–Mar consumption plus a temporary credit buffer, but Finance needs a couple of guardrails (listed below) before we commit.

Immediate next steps we propose:
- Marissa (Finance) to confirm temporary cap & approval path.
- Provide a signed SOW addendum or DocuSign envelope for the credit buffer and term change.
- Confirmation of VAT reverse-charge evidence (receipt of VAT cert + EU VAT number).

I’ll leave the specifics to Marissa and Rishi on staggered invoicing options that help mitigate Redwood exposure. Would ThermoCare be open to staggered invoicing tied to milestone consumption (e.g., 40/30/30 split through March)?

Priyom
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-11T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Credit buffer request and VAT routing for Q1 consumption

Priyom — reviewing. Finance position and required documentation:

1) Credit cap: We can provisionally approve a temporary credit buffer of $125,000 for up to 90 days, subject to:
   - Signed SOW addendum agreeing to Net45 for Feb–Mar invoices
   - PO on file (received)
   - Company credit review (basic AML/KYC) — ask completed, no red flags so far.

2) Invoicing cadence options to reduce exposure:
   - Option A (preferred): Staggered invoicing aligned to consumption milestones (40% invoice at start of month, 30% mid-month, 30% at month end).
   - Option B: Standard monthly invoicing but with a hard credit cap that triggers prepayment for any usage beyond the cap.

3) VAT: For reverse-charge we need the EU VAT ID and VAT certificate — we'll add the reverse-charge note to invoices and set the VAT line to 0. If ThermoCare is registered in an EU member state with valid VAT ID, no local VAT should be charged. Please confirm the exact VAT ID to place on the invoices.

4) Legal/Contracting: Laura — can your team prepare a short SOW addendum (1–2 pages) that includes the credit cap, Net45 for specified invoices, and staggered invoicing schedule? We can route via DocuSign.

I'll tentatively mark the request as approved pending the SOW and VAT evidence.

— Marissa
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Aria Kumar <accounts@thermocare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Niels Petersen <niels.p@thermocare.com>
Date: 2027-02-12T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Credit buffer request and VAT routing for Q1 consumption

Marissa — thanks, that's helpful. VAT ID: GB999888777. Attached is the ThermoCare VAT certificate and the signed PO.

About invoicing cadence, ThermoCare is fine with Option A (staggered invoicing). The PO will cover the first two milestones and we can top up if usage exceeds the buffer — we'll assume any overage will be invoiced and paid Net45 as well.

We'd prefer to avoid monthly prepayment if possible — staggered invoices are workable. Please send the SOW addendum and the DocuSign link and we'll get it signed today.

Attachments: ThermoCare_VAT_certificate.pdf, TC_PO_2027Q1.pdf

Thanks,
Aria

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-13T11:45:00Z
Subject: Proposed invoicing schedule and exposure mitigation

Team — quick note on how we can operationalize this without adding risk:

- Credit cap: $125,000 for up to 90 days (until 2027-04-30).
- Invoicing schedule (staggered): 40% at service start, 30% mid-cycle (auto-generated when usage hits 60% of expected monthly run-rate), 30% at month end. This requires us to enable mid-cycle usage thresholds in billing (we can do this behind the scenes).
- Overages beyond $125k: automatic hold on further provisioning and a one-week grace before suspension unless prepayment is received.
- VAT handling: Once VAT ID is uploaded to our billing portal and we receive the certificate (pdf attached), mark invoices as reverse-charge — VAT = 0 and include the phrase "VAT reverse charge; customer EU VAT ID provided" on invoice.

I'll draft the SOW addendum with those bullets and route to Laura/Legal. Priyom — if you can send the DocuSign envelope to Aria, we'll be ready to sign.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Aria Kumar <accounts@thermocare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-17T16:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Credit buffer request and VAT routing for Q1 consumption

Aria — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary and next steps (agreed):

- Temporary credit buffer: $125,000 approved through 2027-04-30.
- Payment terms: Net45 for invoices generated in Feb–Mar 2027 (applies to staggered invoices and any overage invoices).
- Invoicing cadence: Staggered 40/30/30 as described by Rishi. Mid-cycle invoice triggers based on consumption thresholds.
- VAT: Reverse-charge will be applied once ThermoCare's VAT certificate is uploaded; VAT ID GB999888777 will appear on invoices.
- Contingency: Overages beyond the cap will trigger provisioning hold and one-week grace before suspension unless prepayment is provided.

Action items:
- Laura/Legal to send 1–2 page SOW addendum (attached: amended_sow_thermocare_v2.pdf).
- Priyom to open DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC-THERMO-2027
- Aria/Niels to countersign and confirm VAT certificate upload to our billing portal.

Once signed, Finance will mark the account for the temporary net-term change and confirm billing automation. Great to get this moving — looking forward to a smooth pilot.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
